shortBio.en: The Police drummer; reggae hi-hat grammar and octoban color inside trio pop-rock.
shortBio.zh: The Police 鼓手；三人流行摇滚里的雷鬼踩镲语法与八角鼓色彩。

body.en: Founding drummer. Treats the kit as a percussion rack—hi-hat chatter, space, few meat-and-potatoes rock fills. Tension with Sting is part of the band’s endgame lore.
body.zh: 创始鼓手。把鼓组当打击乐架——踩镲碎语、留白、少见肉蛋洋葱式摇滚加花。与 Sting 的张力是乐队终局传说的一部分。
